blocks.text: STR:000–022 DETAILED REVIEW AND DELEGATED APPROVAL — CANONICAL

The first Structure block was reconsidered from first principles. The review compared five architectures per root, scored 45 candidates across 360 criterion values, routed 85 English concepts without forced atomization, passed all 17 reusable packet checks, passed all 18 structural entity-layer soundness checks, and passed the complete 29-check authority regression. All deterministic generated forms remained unchanged.

Approved architecture: STR:0xx names substrate-neutral structural loci and arrangements. The inward triplet names a constituent position inside one structure; the outward triplet names a boundary interface for structural engagement by a distinct external target; and the systemic triplet names a part–whole arrangement across multiple constituent positions.
STR:000 — persistent constituent position — A position within a structure that remains identified as a place for one constituent independently of its present occupancy.
STR:001 — occupied constituent position — A position within a structure that is presently occupied by a constituent.
STR:002 — vacant constituent position — A position within a structure that is defined for a constituent but presently unoccupied.
STR:010 — persistent structural interface — A boundary locus of a structure that remains identified for structural engagement by a distinct external target.
STR:011 — engaged structural interface — A boundary locus of a structure that is presently engaged by a distinct external target.
STR:012 — unengaged structural interface — A boundary locus of a structure that is defined for engagement by a distinct external target but presently unengaged.
STR:020 — persistent composite arrangement — A part–whole arrangement that remains identified as one structure across multiple constituent positions.
STR:021 — instantiated composite arrangement — A part–whole arrangement that is presently realized as one structure by constituents occupying multiple constituent positions.
STR:022 — dormant composite arrangement — A part–whole arrangement that is defined across multiple constituent positions without presently being realized as one structure.

Design boundary: a constituent position is not its occupant, material, coordinate, label, type, function, or institutional role. A structural interface is not a communication endpoint, protocol, compatibility conclusion, or attachment relation. A composite arrangement is not a blueprint, graph record, institution, functioning mechanism, or construction process. Vacancy, disengagement, and dormancy do not imply damage, reservation, planning, scheduling, future use, or repair need.
